_notes._: Reviewed known violations. Each rule says why it is accepted for now and where it is tracked. Counts are violating nodes per rule per component; see specs/axe.spec.ts.
_notes.aria-allowed-attr: Untracked: aria-expanded on the plain <input> inside date-picker and on the hover-card trigger wrapper, which have no role that allows it; the role belongs on the focusable element.
_notes.aria-dialog-name: Untracked: the hover-card body is role=dialog with no name (noted in hover-card.ts).
_notes.aria-input-field-name: Untracked duplicate roles: void-textarea, void-slider, void-number-input and void-tags-input put an unnamed widget role on the host while the inner native control is the real, labelled one.
_notes.aria-required-children: Untracked: void-tags-input is role=listbox around a text input; void-nav-menu (menubar) holds plain links.
_notes.aria-required-parent: Untracked: void-tag is role=listitem even outside a list.
_notes.label: Untracked: the compact void-color-picker's hex input has no label.
_notes.landmark-banner-is-top-level: Untracked: void-banner is role=banner, a page landmark, even when used as an in-page notice inside <main>.
_notes.nested-interactive: Untracked duplicate roles: slider and color-picker hosts are focusable widgets around native controls; a void-button wrapping an <a> (link button) is a button around a link.
_notes.scrollable-region-focusable: Untracked: void-scroll-area's viewport cannot be scrolled by keyboard unless its content is focusable.
_notes.target-size: Untracked: sidebar and breadcrumb links, carousel indicators and the compact colour input are under 24x24 px; the link button's anchor is partly covered by its host's padding.
